static_checks.kind: Bounded unchanged native Node initializers with four exact memcpy seams; no unreviewed control flow or native writes outside scratch stack

limitations: No source compilation, tests that compile code, original-game launch, rebuilt-game launch, screenshot comparison, or runtime parity check.
Ghidra raw slices lack full-program symbols/types and embedded data; assembly/full-PE literals corroborate the recovered values.

Current common Canvas fit/scale and propagated component were recovered statically; existing source matches primary-window path. Multi-window/non-window rendering routes and runtime behavior remain unverified.

canvas_contract.logical_window: physical width,height divided by selected Window scale override or platform DPI factor
canvas_contract.target_scale: fit * camera.target_scaling_factor * UiScale for camera window target; fit * UiScale for non-window target

component_payload.byte12: queued insertion-mode bool, not part of component

type_reference_instructions.note: LEA current type literal and length76 preceding component/bundle registration call

canvas_contract.source_match: Existing canvas.rs primary-window/single default-camera fit, offsets, viewport payload and scale multiplication match current native route. No source change needed.
limits: Multi-window/non-window rendering paths not fully reconstructed in existing canvas.rs; outside terminal single-window use.
Static recovery does not establish rendering parity or runtime resize behavior.
